# OpenCompass Benchmark Environment Requirements
# Equivalent to: rdagent/scenarios/finetune/docker/opencompass/Dockerfile

# PyTorch 2.9.0 with CUDA 12.8 (for B200 GPUs with sm_100 architecture)
# Note: PyTorch 2.1.0 only supports up to sm_90, B200 requires 2.8.0+
# For non-B200 machines with CUDA 12.4, change to cu124 and torch==2.6.0
# Keep PyPI as the primary index while making the pinned CUDA wheels visible.
# Requirements-file index options are global, so two --index-url directives do
# not scope the first index to Torch and leave Torch unresolvable.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
torch==2.9.0
torchvision==0.24.0

# vLLM 0.12.0 is the release matched to PyTorch 2.9.0. A lower bound would
# currently resolve to newer vLLM releases that replace the pinned Torch build.
vllm==0.12.0

# MMEngine's OpenCompass config loader still imports pkg_resources, which was
# removed in Setuptools 81.
setuptools==80.9.0

# OpenCompass benchmark framework (custom fork with cascade eval support).
# Pinned archive avoids an unversioned Git checkout and works where Git smart HTTP is blocked.
opencompass @ https://codeload.github.com/Jensen246/opencompass/tar.gz/abc7c91a485bc1e3188e71e330a7140be385da29

# Math evaluation dependencies (matches Dockerfile line 22)
math_verify
latex2sympy2_extended
